hero.title: Complete care and support for your loved one's final journey.
hero.description: In difficult moments, your family should not have to face confusion or run around for arrangements. We assist you gently with everything — respectful ceremonial transport, hospital clearance, crematorium entry, flowers, and prayer meetings. Our team stays with you with complete warmth and care.
hero.imageAlt: Eternal Repos tribute vehicle and ceremonial care team standing beside a family

fiveCircles.title: Five ways we stand beside you.
fiveCircles.description: From the very first call to the days following the farewell, we are here to support your family step by step with gentle, respectful care.
fiveCircles.caption: Five circles of care, held on a single thread — from the first call to the days long after.

items.title: Immediate Help & Ceremonial Transport
items.description: Clean, air-conditioned vehicle from hospital or home to the cremation ground. Includes complete help with hospital paperwork, gate passes, and an extra car for family members.

items.title: Prayer Hall & Floral Services
items.description: Arranging quiet prayer halls (Shok Sabha), flower decorations, simple tea and snacks for guests, and heartfelt obituary messages with trusted local partners.

items.title: Family Support
items.description: Simple step-by-step guidance for Asthi Visarjan (Haridwar, Garhmukteshwar, and sacred rivers) with comfortable cars and caring emotional support whenever you need.

items.title: Pre-Planning
items.description: Thoughtful advance plans being developed to arrange services ahead of time, ensuring clarity and protecting your family from sudden stress.

items.title: Special Assistance
items.description: Help when taking your loved one to a hometown outside Delhi NCR, including interstate travel permits, police and hospital clearances, and international repatriation support.

packagesSection.title: Farewell Care Packages
packagesSection.description: Every detail itemized and clearly explained, so your family knows exactly what to expect with no hidden surprises.
packagesSection.footnote: Every farewell is sacred and personal. All packages can be customised according to your family's religious customs, priest traditions, and specific floral preferences.

howItWorksSection.title: What happens when you call us?
howItWorksSection.description: We handle every arrangement step by step with quiet care, so your family does not have to worry about running around.

areasSection.title: Where our team serves
areasSection.description: Our team and clean ceremonial vehicles are active 24×7 across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, and Faridabad to reach your location promptly with courteous support.
areasSection.footnote: Intercity transfers beyond Delhi NCR and international repatriation logistics are coordinated on a case-by-case basis.

verse.text: We cannot make the weight lighter — only carry it with you.

seo.title: Funeral Transport & Coordination Services in Delhi NCR | Eternal Repos
seo.description: Eternal Repos provides 24×7 dignified funeral transport, documentation support, funeral coordination and specialised assistance across Delhi NCR.
